description: Named the Nexben call prep PDF with an ISO-date-prefixed, lowercase-hyphenated filename ('2026-07-01-nexben-discussion-prep.pdf') and uploaded it to reMarkable that way, violating the Output Naming Conventions in agents/conventions.md. Deliverable files (PDF/HTML/PPTX for reading or sharing) should use human-readable names with no date prefix unless the date is part of the document's identity — e.g. 'Nexben Call Prep.pdf'.
correction: Rename the deliverable to a human-readable title-case name with no ISO date prefix (e.g. 'Nexben Call Prep.pdf'), replace the incorrectly-named file on reMarkable with the corrected one.
